current_work: IdentityPeerAuthoritySnapshot captures logical peer, authority epoch, holder, directory revision, last committed peer-update identity and evidence time.
IdentityPeerAuthorityJournal is the restart/recovery authority boundary for those application-level facts.
Recovery rejects a different authority holder claiming the same epoch.
XTP delivery, transport ACK and replay state cannot satisfy LDAP application commit authority.
